title: Bang for the Buck
summary:
Bang for the Buck
The increase in vessel prices across all sectors has clearly raised the stakes for both shipowners and finance groups that are interested in asset plays. Shipping is an international business with various currencies changing hands. This adds another dimension of financial risk.
